svg.title: Why a good product brings the next customers
svg.desc: Cycle of 5 steps: 1 Better product (from feedback); 2 Happy customers; 3 Word of mouth; 4 More customers; 5 Revenue to invest; the last leads back to Better product. Every step feeds the hub Customers (at the center). Links: Better product: delights; Happy customers: stay on; Word of mouth: refer; More customers: inform; Revenue to invest: reinvest.
svg.text: Why a good product brings the next customers
